text:
Anika Patel: Heads-up — Acme onboarding goes live tomorrow 09:00 PST. Quick customer-facing checklist I want to share in the kickoff: connectivity probe, run a small sample prompt suite, verify telemetry hooks, and a lightweight renewal-risk signal capture. Posting the snippets below for eng/SRE and the CS playbook so we can send a single note to the customer.

Ravi Menon: Perfect. For connectivity the simplest smoke is a token-validated health check. Paste this to customers who want a one-liner: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST \"https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate\" \-H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \-H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \-d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"ping"}'
```
It returns quickly and shows model+latency. Add region param if they use dedicated/private.

Nate Li: For the sample prompt suite I suggest 3 short flows: auth check (hello/ping), constrained-length generation (1–2 tokens? more like short completion), and streaming path. Example prompt we give them: 
```
System: You are an assistant that summarizes commit messages.
User: Summarize: "fix: handle nil pointer in auth middleware"
```
Also include a streaming example snippet for SDK users so they can validate sockets.

Priya Gomez: Telemetry hooks: remind them to enable request_id passthrough and include a customer_user_id in metadata. Minimal set we ask for in the checklist: request_id, route, model, latency_ms, token_count, error_code. We also have a small JSON snippet they can post to our webhook to register their telemetry forwarder.

Anika Patel: Nice. Can someone add a one-paragraph note we can paste in the customer kickoff email that explains the goal and the fallbacks? I want simple language for non-technical PMs.

Ravi Menon: Paste this copy into emails: "We'll run three quick checks before full traffic: (1) API connectivity, (2) example prompt runs to validate latency and output, (3) telemetry wiring so we can monitor health. If any check fails, we'll automatically switch to the fallback model variant and notify your team while we triage. Expect ~15–30 minutes for the on-call run if we need a fix." :white_check_mark:

Nate Li: For renewal-risk capture: CS should ask two rapid signals during the first week: 1) Are latency and cost within your expected thresholds? 2) Are outputs meeting quality expectations for 3 representative prompts? Record answers in the onboarding tracker; mark "at-risk" if either is negative and assign to eng for a follow-up.

Anika Patel: Love it. I'll consolidate and send to Acme. Priya — can you add the telemetry snippet to the doc and ping me? Ravi/Nate — I'll cc you on the kickoff email so you can help troubleshoot live.

oncall-bot: Reminder set for 2024-06-15T09:00:00Z to run the post-kickoff health check.

Priya Gomez: Added telemetry snippet to the doc and left a short checklist checkbox list so CS can tick off during the call. Sending now. :rocket:

Anika Patel: Thanks everyone — sending the note in 10. If anything pops during the call ping #eng-oncall or add an incident in the portal. :thumbsup:
